remarks: Welcome to this charming English Tudor-style home nestled in a serene neighborhood on a dead-end street! This delightful property offers a perfect blend of character, modern convenience, and lots of charm. Characterized by its distinctive architectural elements, including steeply pitched roofs, decorative half-timbering, and arched doorways, this English Tudor-style home exudes timeless charm. Situated in a tranquil neighborhood, providing a peaceful and private retreat while still being conveniently located near schools, parks, shopping centers, major transportation routes and so much more. With 4 bedrooms providing ample space for relaxation and privacy with a full well-appointed bathroom featuring modern fixtures and finishes. Enjoy refreshing dips and endless summer fun in the above-ground pool directly off the newly finished large deck space, perfect for entertaining family and friends. Tall basement ceiling offers great potential for additional living space, storage, or customization according to your needs and preferences. No need to park outside with covered garage space at the end of the private driveway. Don't miss out on the opportunity to make this charming English Tudor-style home your own! Additional features of house, roof is 3 yrs old, bathroom shower and tun comes with lifetime warranty and heated above ground pool comes with additional warranty.
